highlights.label: Frontend Architecture & Global Leadership
highlights.text: Lead developer for the SmartThings Developer Console, unifying UX across multiple web products while partnering with global teams (Poland, Indonesia, Korea) to integrate cross-functional features.
highlights.short: Lead developer for the Developer Console, partnering with teams in Poland, Indonesia and Korea.

highlights.label: AI Integration & Tooling
highlights.text: Actively contributed to the company's AI pilot program as a designated power user. Engineered a template repository providing AI-driven prompts and skills to bootstrap product integrations.
highlights.short: Designated power user in the company’s AI pilot; built a template repo of prompts and skills to bootstrap integrations.

highlights.label: End-to-End Product Leadership
highlights.text: Initiated and led the complete refactoring of the platform's onboarding experience, taking proactive ownership to drive the project from proof-of-concept to a successful production release.
highlights.short: Led the onboarding refactor from proof-of-concept to production.

highlights.label: Developer Experience (DX) Infrastructure
highlights.text: Streamlined platform development by building a React component library that enforced Samsung's One Design guidelines to unify cross-brand UX, managing zero-break global NPM releases, and maintaining a JavaScript SDK autogenerated from OpenAPI specifications.
highlights.short: Built the React component library enforcing Samsung One Design, with zero-break NPM releases.

highlights.label: Frontend Transition
highlights.text: Transitioned to web frontend development for ARTIK Cloud, instrumental in launching the Developer Workspace (a portal for managing SmartThings integrations).
highlights.short: Moved to web frontend for ARTIK Cloud and helped launch the Developer Workspace.

highlights.label: SDK Development
highlights.text: Developed a modern JavaScript SDK and specialized Starter Kits to improve the 3rd-party developer experience.
highlights.short: Built a modern JavaScript SDK and Starter Kits for 3rd-party developers.

highlights.label: Cross-Platform Maintenance
highlights.text: Maintained ARTIK Cloud's iOS developer tooling alongside web responsibilities.
highlights.short: Kept ARTIK Cloud’s iOS developer tooling running alongside the web work.

highlights.label: Executive Collaboration
highlights.text: Hired directly under executive leadership (Luc Julia, co-creator of Siri) to serve as the lead iOS developer for ARTIK Cloud.
highlights.short: Hired under Luc Julia (co-creator of Siri) as lead iOS developer for ARTIK Cloud.

highlights.label: App Engineering
highlights.text: Conceptualized and engineered the ARTIK Cloud iOS application from the ground up.
highlights.short: Designed and built the ARTIK Cloud iOS app from the ground up.

highlights.label: Universal SDK
highlights.text: Developed and maintained a Universal Framework (SDK) enabling 3rd-party developers to build natively across iOS, tvOS, watchOS, and macOS.
highlights.short: Shipped a universal SDK for iOS, tvOS, watchOS and macOS.

highlights.label: OS Optimization
highlights.text: Navigated strict Apple OS limitations (background task restrictions, location tracking) to ensure seamless application performance and reliable data syncing.
highlights.short: Worked within Apple’s background and location limits to keep data syncing reliable.

highlights.label: Full-Stack Engineering
highlights.text: Engineered an iOS application and its supporting backend architecture designed for automated, smart image classification.
highlights.short: Built an iOS app and its backend for automated image classification.

highlights.label: Computer Vision
highlights.text: Pioneered a computer vision–driven photo classification system predating native iOS Visual Search, utilizing OpenCV, Tesseract, and Python to identify apps from screenshots and execute Deep Link Lookups.
highlights.short: Identified apps from screenshots with OpenCV and Tesseract, before iOS Visual Search existed.

highlights.label: API Architecture
highlights.text: Designed a highly performant and scalable REST API backed by a PostgreSQL database with Redis caching.
highlights.short: Designed a REST API on PostgreSQL with Redis caching.

highlights.label: HIPAA-Compliant Mobile App
highlights.text: Developed an end-to-end encrypted Android application to facilitate secure, confidential document sharing between patients and medical professionals in strict accordance with HIPAA regulations.
highlights.short: Built an end-to-end encrypted, HIPAA-compliant Android app for patient document sharing.

highlights.label: Data Synchronization
highlights.text: Architected the data synchronization flow using an internal SQLite database communicating with a Python/MySQL backend.
highlights.short: Designed the sync between on-device SQLite and a Python/MySQL backend.
